title: C lichen_rpl_sequence_compare still uses pre-RFC-7.2 lollipop rules
description: lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/rpl_dao_build.c lichen_rpl_sequence_compare still treats mixed linear/circular as linear-always-newer and circular diffs as (a-b)&0x7F in (0,16], plus same-region linear as plain numeric compare with no SEQUENCE_WINDOW incomparability. That is the same RFC 6550 Section 7.2 divergence that worker6-y4yy fixed for static version_is_newer in dodag.c. DAO Path Sequence / DAOSequence should use the same lollipop_cmp (SEQUENCE_WINDOW=16, wrap distance, incomparable). Do not silently share a private static; extract or duplicate the corrected rules. Out of scope for y4yy (dodag.c version_is_newer only).
close_reason: Aligned lichen_rpl_sequence_compare in lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/rpl_dao_build.c with RFC 6550 Section 7.2 SEQUENCE_WINDOW=16 (duplicated dodag.c dao_lollipop_cmp: same-region |diff|>16 incomparable, cross-region wrap distance). Path Sequence / DAOSequence are 8-bit lollipops (RFC 6550 7.1-7.2), not RFC 1982 serial numbers; increment_lollipop 127->0 is newer and 0->127 is stale (same version-like wrap as version_is_newer, both directions for the 4-way API). Signature unchanged. Host test: cmake -S lichen/tests/rpl_dao_sequence -B lichen/tests/rpl_dao_sequence/build && cmake --build ... && ./.../rpl_dao_sequence_test → 4/4 passed (ctest 1/1). clang-tidy TEST TU clean.
